info.name: Workday Integrations Workday Prism Analytics Benefits Reports API

params.name: reportOwner
params.description: Username of the report owner in Workday (the ISU account or integration system user that owns the report)

params.name: reportName
params.description: Name of the custom report as defined in Workday. Must match the report name exactly, using underscores for spaces.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format for the report data

params.name: Employee_ID
params.description: Filter by Employee ID (example prompt parameter; actual parameters depend on report configuration)

params.name: Effective_Date
params.description: Filter by effective date in YYYY-MM-DD format (example prompt parameter)

params.name: Organization
params.description: Filter by organization WID or reference ID (example prompt parameter)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination

items.docs: Execute a Workday custom report and retrieve its data. The report must have web service enabled. Returns data in JSON format by default, with support for CSV and XML via the format parameter. Supports prompt-based filtering through query parameters matching report prompt names.
